I have well irrigation, so I will use water to protect yield, but because my land is small and some family members work off-farm, I will avoid management that is too labor-intensive or risky. For wheat, I will use improved seed, apply moderate fertilizer, irrigate a few key times, and keep pesticide use limited but timely. For summer maize, I will use hybrid seed because I care most about stable yield on my small area, and I will fertilize a bit more nitrogen than wheat. I will continue rotary tillage because it fits my equipment and habits, and it is easier for me at my age than heavier tillage. I will not push inputs too high because I want reliable output, manageable costs, and work I can finish with my household labor.
